instruction: Please help me change the font family in VS Code to Consolas.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.fontFamily": "monospace"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.fontFamily" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.fontFamily": "[^"]*"/"editor.fontFamily": "monospace"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.fontFamily": "monospace"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code font family from 'monospace' to 'Consolas'. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.fontFamily setting in settings.json.
